critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomNav.jsx uses data-testid for all navigation buttons (mobile-nav-home, mobile-nav-catalogue, mobile-nav-programme, mobile-nav-pro)
Service Worker (sw.js) implements proper caching strategies: cache-first for static, network-first for API, stale-while-revalidate for dynamic
manifest.json has shortcuts for Dashboard CC2026, Espace Pro, and Catalogue with correct URLs
SmartAnalytics.js tracks intro_section_click events for analyzing user interactions with intro sequence
OfflineCache.js uses IndexedDB for offline task storage with sync queue for pending actions
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA features tested and working. IntroSequence shows on first visit and blocks navigation until skipped (localStorage kk_visited=true). Cookie banner also appears and needs to be dismissed. After both are cleared, mobile bottom navigation works correctly. Service Worker is registered and active. Use localStorage.setItem('kk_visited', 'true') and localStorage.setItem('cc2026_cookies_accepted', 'true') in tests to bypass intro and cookies.
